# Network Edge Virtual Device Aruba SubModule

The Network Edge Virtual Device Aruba Module will create Aruba autonomous mode devices on the Equinix
Network edge platform.

1. Single or Non HA device
2. HA devices

Please refer to the aruba-* examples in this module's registry for more details on how to leverage the
submodule.
